title: TYPES OF THEOLOGY
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the object of God's unqualified and outgoing love (John 3:16)."
The world is the object of God's unqualified and outgoing love (John 3:16).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the product of theological complications arising from the encounter between Africans and Western missionary activities."
African Theology is the product of theological complications arising from the encounter between Africans and Western missionary activities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a theological formulation committed to the poor. d."
Liberation Theology is a theological formulation committed to the poor. d.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the primary source and data for theology."
Philosophy is the primary source and data for theology.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a development that has been debated in terms of its explication."
Contextual theology is a development that has been debated in terms of its explication.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most basic strand upon which the other concepts are understood."
The sovereignty of God is the most basic strand upon which the other concepts are understood.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the leading function of Biblical revelation: (1) More pointedly, redemptive character: it is a redemptive revelation and of crucial significance in a world order corrupted by sin."
Two facets are the leading function of Biblical revelation: (1) More pointedly, redemptive character: it is a redemptive revelation and of crucial significance in a world order corrupted by sin.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a resting, repose in our God and his righteousness, which is restless for God and his righteousness."
Faith is a resting, repose in our God and his righteousness, which is restless for God and his righteousness.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the art, science, or theories of interpretation b."
Hermeneutics is the art, science, or theories of interpretation b.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the self-revealing God active in his revelation."
The object of God is the self-revealing God active in his revelation.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a "realistic Christology" that deals pragmatically with present problems, while conservative Christology is often philosophical and abstract."
Pentecostal Christology is a "realistic Christology" that deals pragmatically with present problems, while conservative Christology is often philosophical and abstract.
fib: ______ is the principium (or ultimate norm) of theology.
Revelation
Revelation is the principium (or ultimate norm) of theology.
______ is a response to the socio-political segregation the Blacks have suffered in North America.
Black Theology
Black Theology is a response to the socio-political segregation the Blacks have suffered in North America.

difference
The difference is the place and cultures-the setting of the faith that "seeks to understand." Because the settings change, the questions change.

God

Contextualization
Contextualization is an inherent dynamic of the Christian faith.

Protestantism
Protestantism is a branch of Western Christianity that rejects the authority of the Pope of the Roman Catholic Church.

Gustavo Gutierrez
Gustavo Gutierrez is regarded as the father of Liberation Theology.
______ is the speaking of God; it is the speaking of God in the most direct and proper sense.
Bible
The Bible is the speaking of God; it is the speaking of God in the most direct and proper sense.

Philosophical theology

Scripture

types of Theology
